capabilities: Track daily words and characters written
Set daily writing goals and count streaks
Visualize writing history as a heatmap
Embed heatmaps, stat slots, and daily entries via code blocks
Sync and merge statistics across devices
disambiguation: Not about music or pacing; the name refers to keeping a consistent daily writing habit.
extras: Data stays local in a JSON file in the plugin's data directory; device merging relies on Obsidian Sync or similar vault syncing.
intentEvidence: I built this plugin after finding that Better Word Count, while useful, had issues with Obsidian Sync
motivation: The author built it after Better Word Count's statistics were overwritten when switching between devices with Obsidian Sync.
problem: Obsidian's word count shows a live count only; it does not track daily writing totals over time, goals, streaks, or per-device history.

relations.evidence: Why not use Better Word Count? I built this plugin after finding that Better Word Count
had issues with Obsidian Sync - stats would get overwritten when switching between devices
Click cells to jump to daily notes (uses Obsidian's core plugin Daily Notes)

summary: Writing habit tracker that records daily word and character counts, tracks goals and streaks, and shows a heatmap sidebar plus embeddable widgets.
